review.name: Review

investigate.duty: Find the cause of the problem in the brief: reproduce it, trace it to the code and note the evidence. Do not fix it yet.

correctness_review.name: Correctness review
correctness_review.duty: Check the change for logic errors, missed edge cases and missing tests. Tie each finding to specific code.

security_review.name: Security review

research.name: Research
